استوجبوا (form X)
# اِسْتَوْجَبُوا (istawjabū) /is.taw.d͡ʒa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَوْجَبَ (istawjaba)
# اُسْتُوجِبُوا (ustūjibū) /us.tuː.d͡ʒi.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَوْجَبَ (istawjaba)
# اِسْتَوْجِبُوا (istawjibū) /is.taw.d͡ʒi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَوْجَبَ (istawjaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
